fanart_file.title: Fanart File
fanart_file.intro: Review incoming fanart, match each image to the right game and character, then queue everything for batch processing.

fanart_album.title: Fanart Album
fanart_album.intro: Browse your saved fanart library, move through subfolders from the side panel, and preview images without leaving the page.

fanart_setting.title: Fanart Setting
fanart_setting.intro: Set the source folder for new downloads, destination root, and the filename format used when fanart is exported.

album_setting.title: Album Setting
album_setting.intro: Add one or more album library paths here. The album viewer will let you switch between them and browse their subfolders.
